items.title: npm now places a temporary 72-hour 'security hold'
items.blurb: npm now places a temporary 72-hour security hold on any account after a successful recovery-code sign-in, extending a protection that previously applied only to high-impact accounts. This change applies to…

items.title: the OpenJS Foundation's CVE team is taking a break
items.blurb: To combat volunteer burnout driven by a surge in AI-generated vulnerability reports, the OpenJS Foundation CNA will temporarily pause all security operations from September 17 to October 6, 2026.

items.title: 'Nobody Pays for Open Source: We Can Force Them To'
items.blurb: Thirty years of voluntary funding schemes haven't paid open source maintainers because asking doesn't scale. The real money already flows — to JFrog, Docker, Sonatype — at the registry layer.

items.title: A Deep Dive into StyleX
items.blurb: Learn how StyleX turns JavaScript style objects into regular CSS classes at build time, with React and Astro setup, variants, themes, and responsive styles.

items.title: SnapDOM 3.0: Turn DOM Elements Into Images, Canvas and More
items.blurb: Capture web interfaces as reusable images and canvas. Plugins add HTML, context for agents, PDF, GIF and video. MIT licensed, with zero core dependencies.

items.title: TanStack Charts Introduced with a Framework Agnostic Grammar of Graphics for TypeScript
items.blurb: TanStack Charts is a new, framework-agnostic visualization library for TypeScript. It allows developers to create visualizations by composing various elements instead of using fixed chart types.

items.title: Workshop: From an Error to the Logs That Explain It
items.blurb: Sentry Logs are an important piece of your debugging toolkit. Learn how to use logs alongside traces and errors to find root causes faster, preserve context across service boundaries, and tune signal instead of drowning in noise.
